failure.invariant: Ternal Kubernetes workloads use disposable local caches and never claim PVC-backed database persistence.
failure.trigger: A chart change emits a PVC reference or enables the retired persistence setting.
failure.mechanism: PVC-backed /data incorrectly competes with Rhiza certified object storage as the persistence authority.
failure.impact: Operators can infer the wrong recovery contract and deploy an unqualified dual-persistence topology.

root.cause: The initial HA design treated stable pod identity as requiring stable local storage instead of preserving Rhiza object storage as the sole persistence authority.
root.detection_gap: The prior render check accepted production PVCs and did not exercise the retired persistence value as a negative fixture.

replay.oracle: The same Helm render control rejects persistence.enabled=true, accepts the emptyDir chart, and scans current durable renders for PVC resources and references.
